dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible interlocking and discrete O-shaped structures with thin, high-contrast dark perimeters. The geometry is characterized by sharp exterior boundaries that transition into lighter, lower-intensity interior cores, particularly prominent in the upper-right quadrant.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Sparse density of small, solid low-intensity pixel clusters (dark spots) lacking internal gradients, primarily located in the interstitial spaces between the larger ring-like structures.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most distinct circular annuli in the central-right region form an obtuse triangle, while the larger grouping of five prominent structures forms an irregular, elongated polygon along the dorsal-lateral curve.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A single, highly saturated orange/red circular feature is present on the upper dorsal ridge, exhibiting a sharp, artificial boundary against the surrounding organic texture.
other_distinctive_markers: The overall texture exhibits a complex reticulated or tessellated pattern where the boundaries of individual annuli often merge to create a continuous web-like lattice across the flank.
